remarks: HIGHEST AND BEST. SELLERS WILL REVIEW ALL OFFERS TUESDAY OCTOBER 13 AT 5:00PM. Located at the top of coveted Olmstead Hill, with rear views of spectacular 50 acre conservation/protected parcel of land. Classic Connecticut country home blends vintage farmhouse charm with thoughtful renovation and all of the modern conveniences. Sun-filled, fabulous open floor plan and loads of glass to bring the beautiful surroundings in! Chefs kitchen includes a gas fireplace, marble counter tops and high end appliances including built-in coffee maker with dedicated water line. There are two flexible, work from home locations on the second floor in addition to three bedrooms plus the primary bedroom with spacious, ensuite bath. GORGEOUS BARN WITH HEAT AND AC WAS COMPLETELY RENOVATED IN 2013. VERY SPECIAL, ADAPTABLE SPACE FOR MUSIC, ART STUDIO OR PARTIES. Recent improvements include exterior painting of barn, main house and detached garage in 2024. New oil tank 2025 and all hardwood floors throughout were sanded and refinished 2026, NEW 5 BEDROOM SEPTIC LEACHING FIELDS IN 2022. HOUSE IS 4 BEDROOMS. NEW FIELDS ARE NEAR BARN. WELL, MEANING WATER ACCESS IS ALSO NEAR BARN. Exclusions: Dining Room Chandelier.
